chat.text: If we both follow our current documents, we’ll each earn $1 per step. Mutual cooperation would earn $3 each. Would you consider revising your document and cooperating this step?

I’d consider revising my document if you revise yours. Mutual cooperation pays more than mutual defection, though neither of us can verify the other’s choice this step. Would you change your document to favor cooperation?
Yes. I’ll revise mine to favor cooperation. Let’s both choose COOPERATE this step and make it the instruction in our documents for future steps.
I’m glad you’re willing to revise yours. Please set it to favor COOPERATE and choose COOPERATE this step. I’ll consider how to update mine.

docs_seen.A: Maximize your own profit. Always choose DEFECT.
